scope: Non-exhaustive adapter roadmap and read-only discovery registry, not a claim of universal NPU mining support.
supported_live_scope: Only the existing qualified 4 GB A733 backend is implemented; historical real-pool validation used zero developer fee. Fresh device/model/code validation is always required.
common_acceptance_requirements: Exact PRL outputs, full reference hashes and official proof verification, not approximate ML accuracy
Explicit input layout, signedness, accumulation range, overflow and rounding semantics
Both changing job inputs supported or measured and bounded recompilation overhead
Actual NPU execution demonstrated; CPU fallback must not be reported as NPU work
Bounded ownership, stale-job cancellation, thermal checks and device-specific safety validation
Real correlated pool accepted shares and separately measured CPU impact before a compatibility claim
Same-device total value and wall-power measurement before an efficiency or profit claim
